title: Wellness Membership Tenure and the Self-Pay Visit Package Member Discount
content:
**Membership desk Q&A — package discounts for members.**

**How does membership tenure change the member discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier?**
A member whose active Wellness Membership was opened at least **365 days** before the purchase receives **5 percentage points more** than that membership's package discount percentage, and a member whose active membership was opened fewer than **90 days** before the purchase receives **5 percentage points less**, never below zero.

**Which date is used?**
The opened (sign-up) date on the patient's active Wellness Membership; the days are the calendar days from that date to the purchase date.

**What about a member between those marks?**
A membership opened at least 90 but fewer than 365 days before the purchase receives neither adjustment.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical membership with a package discount of 8 percent)**

| Days from the membership's opened date to the purchase | Member discount |
|---|---|
| 365 | 13 percent — the boundary day qualifies |
| 364 | 8 percent — neither adjustment |
| 90 | 8 percent — neither adjustment |
| 89 | 3 percent |

**Never below zero (hypothetical membership with a package discount of 3 percent):** opened 30 days before the purchase, 3 less 5 would be negative, so the member discount is 0 percent.
